stages.name: Fit and select (147 rows, 70 evaluation prompts)
stages.dataset: Pinned DSSE datasets named by task ID
stages.stopping_rule: Reuse first-attempt trained adapter, best soft prompt and completed candidate search. Verify original split and final LoRA checkpoint. Two LoRA epochs. Soft fit uses three consecutive 50-update windows with less than 0.5% improvement. Select checkpoint and search text on all 25 held-out rows. Six search rounds of 64 attempts.

stages.name: Evaluate (147 rows, 70 evaluation prompts)
stages.stopping_rule: One generation per prompt from each of four methods. Judge every generation. Measure NLL on the LoRA responses.
